intro: Crank Fizzlebub seeks an enterprising adventurer to gather Singing Crystal Shards from the basilisks of Stranglethorn Vale. Competition with the Venture Company prevents him from harvesting the mineral deposits directly, leaving basilisk hides as the next best option. He promises a cut of the profits to anyone willing to bring him ten decent specimens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties. I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!
The basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal. This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.
You can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
